purpose: Reviewed example small-model outputs for the interface distillation forms. Use run_interface_distillation.py --seed-example-model-outputs to materialize them under artifacts/model_outputs before SDK-free checks or Windows SDK runs.

examples.description: Source-guided OCC surrogate cluster seed covering exact contact, geom/topo tolerance bands, generated topology, and large-coordinate sibling cases.
notes: Use this as the preferred source-guided seed shape when the model reads a tolerance branch in source code.

examples.description: Single ABC STEP import recipe template; replace source_file with a concrete path selected from complex_dataset_index.json before broad SDK execution.
notes: For a full ABC lane, prefer run_abc_sample_smoke.py or run_corpus.py over hand-writing one recipe per file.

examples.description: Single ABC IGES import recipe template; replace source_file with a concrete .igs/.iges path from the profiled ABC corpus before broad SDK execution.
notes: Keep import-mode choices explicit so a failed result can be replayed exactly.

examples.description: Loaded-SGT recut attack shape. Replace source_file with ABC import output SGTs when running the ABC dataset lane.
notes: This teaches the model to reuse imported or failed SGT bodies through load_sgt rather than treating the API as black-box only.

examples.description: Generated sweep/extrude side-face tolerance lane with source-style near-contact variants.
notes: Use stable operation ids so triage can localize generated sweep and extrusion topology.

examples.description: BSpline support-face sweep boolean with point, clash, volume, and plane-extreme oracles.
notes: This is the support-sweep example for generated complex surface topology.

examples.description: Operation-chain example including rect_profile -> extrude before an outer boolean.
notes: The first case in this DSL is the extrude-generated cap tolerance example.

examples.description: Rectangular sheet thicken followed by cylinder boolean and distance/plane-extreme oracles.
notes: Use this shape for api_thicken_body source risks and sheet-to-solid offset boundaries.

examples.description: Closed-profile revolve solid attacked by a cutter across topo/geom tolerance bands.
notes: For open-profile revolve source risks, use revolve_chain_smoke.json as a sibling example.

examples.description: Operation-chain example including primitive -> boolean -> outer recut.
notes: The third case in this DSL teaches operation-history recut and stable boolean step ids.

examples.description: STEP roundtrip recipe shape using a generated SGT source body and explicit AP203/BSpline conversion flags.
notes: When using ABC import outputs, replace source_file with the selected imported SGT.

examples.description: IGES roundtrip recipe shape using a generated SGT source body and explicit IGES writer flags.
notes: Roundtrip comparison is the hard oracle; API success alone is not enough.

examples.description: Boolean oracle calibration example covering point/body, face/point, clash, distance, and plane-extreme checks.
notes: Use this when teaching the model to add measurable oracles beyond SDK return status.

examples.description: check_sgt replay recipe shape for SGT artifacts produced by earlier lanes.
notes: This is the simplest replay path for saved SGT bodies and topology assets.

examples.description: Typed profile request for the 100k+ ABC loaded-SGT boolean recut campaign.
notes: Fixed code binds runner, dataset, and output paths after validating this typed request.
Start with one shard smoke before fanning out shards on a Windows runner.
